description: Price to park at a lot for a number of hours, at the lot's current rate (daily max applied). No API key needed. booking.mode in the result is the next step: reserve (the reserve tool holds a space) or pay_at_qr_page (booking.pay_url is the lot's pay page, where the driver pays and parks). Every payment completes on parkgraph.com with the driver present; no tool charges money on its own.

duration_hours.description: How long the driver will park, in hours
